extensions.name: ACP 会话后端
extensions.description: 泛用 ACP 驱动 —— 一个适配器接所有 Agent Client Protocol agent（25 家内置自动探测，对齐 agent-shell 全量清单 + 自定义后端面板 + 授权卡/队列/模型目录）
extensions.descriptionEn: A universal ACP driver — one adapter connects all Agent Client Protocol agents (25 built-in with auto-detection + custom backend panel + permission cards/queue/model catalog)
extensions.soulEn: Once the protocol is unified, the adapter only needs to be written once.
extensions.soul: 协议统一了，适配器只需要写一次。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Agent 管理界面
extensions.description: 统一聚合外部 agent 登录态 + 登录操作代理 + 多账号档（备份/别名/一键切换）+ 账号额度显示——不实现任何登录协议
extensions.descriptionEn: Unified aggregation of external agent login states + login action proxying + multi-account profiles (backup/alias/one-click switch) + account quota display — implements no login protocol at all
extensions.soulEn: Six agents' login states on one screen; multi-account rotation, one-click switch.
extensions.soul: 六家 agent 登录态，一屏看尽；多账号轮换，一键切换。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: AI 输入增强
extensions.description: 聊天输入框增强 —— L0/L1 两层自动补全 + 收藏联想 + 🎤 实时 ASR 语音输入（多引擎可插拔/热词/2-pass 精修）+ 听写检测修复
extensions.descriptionEn: Input enhancement for the AI chat composer: two-tier autocomplete (instant local → AI fallback), speech-input detection with spelling repair, streaming ASR with 2-pass refinement, switchable recognition engines (self-hosted / xfyun / Baidu / SiliconFlow / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), hotwords, and usage reports.
extensions.soulEn: Before you finish typing, it has already guessed half of it.
extensions.soul: 你还没打完的字，它已经替你想到一半了。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-ai-schedule
extensions.description: pi-web 常驻调度器 —— 扩展声明式定时任务 + AI 计划（cron/间隔/一次性）+ 三模式执行引擎 + AI 自建计划工具 + 管理页
extensions.descriptionEn: pi-web resident scheduler — extension declarative scheduled tasks + AI plans (cron/interval/one-shot) + three-mode execution engine + AI self-service plan tool + management page
extensions.soul: 别再每个扩展自造 setInterval 了——声明即调度，AI 也能自己排班。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 内置于 pi-web 扩展目录，随 pi-web 启动；门控见下方「门控与部署」

extensions.name: 跟读模式
extensions.description: AI 输出语音朗读——可切音色/暂停/跳过/停止；默认浏览器 Web Speech，可选 edge-tts
extensions.descriptionEn: Voice reading of AI output — browser Web Speech / edge-tts / local TTS (Hojo-TTS-Light, OpenAI-compatible) with cache, voice cloning and pause/skip/stop
extensions.soulEn: You type, it reads it back to you.
extensions.soul: AI 说给你听。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-ai-usage
extensions.description: AI token 用量统计 —— workspace/provider/model/key/时段多维报表，任意多维组合透视 + 桑基图 + CSV 导出，事件驱动零轮询，独立 SQLite 存储
extensions.descriptionEn: AI token usage statistics — multi-dimensional reports by workspace/provider/model/key/time-slot, pivot over any dimension combination + sankey diagram + CSV export, event-driven with zero polling, standalone SQLite storage
extensions.soulEn: Every token should have a traceable destination.
extensions.soul: 用量不是账单来了才知道——每一枚 token 都该有去向。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 应用中心
extensions.description: 左栏区块栈全部折叠后空白态的应用抽屉（开始菜单）——应用视图（动作/面板/管理入口卡，hover 快捷钉 + 信息页）与开关视图（feature 开关按扩展分组）双视图单行切换，tag 式分类（内部固定分类多语 + 自定义分类 + 默认 other）、按视图搜索、编辑模式排序/隐藏/恢复
extensions.descriptionEn: The app drawer (start menu) shown in the blank state after every left-column dock block is collapsed — a single-row switch between the Apps view (action/panel/manage entry cards, hover quick-pin + info page) and the Toggles view (feature toggles grouped by extension), tag-style categories (8 fixed internal categories with i18n + custom categories + default other), search scoped per view, and edit-mode reorder/hide/restore
extensions.soulEn: Home for every plugin entry — collapsed, it becomes the start menu.
extensions.soul: 所有插件入口的家——折叠即开始菜单。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 消费方 session-manager（optionalDependsOn 软依赖）经 aiti-app-center.api 服务渲染进 DockStack filler

extensions.name: 追加系统提示词
extensions.description: 管理 pi 的 APPEND_SYSTEM.md（会话启动时追加进 system prompt）——全局 ~/.pi/agent/ 与项目 <cwd>/.pi/ 两份，网页面板在线编辑保存，🤖 AI 帮你起草并直接写入
extensions.descriptionEn: Two-level appended system prompt management (APPEND_SYSTEM.md): global ~/.pi/agent (all projects) + project <cwd>/.pi (this project only), editable in the browser
extensions.soulEn: One line of reminder, effective every time.
extensions.soul: 一句提醒，次次生效。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 附着会话后端
extensions.description: Socket 附着已运行 agent 进程 —— 连接 pi TUI bridge；支持环境变量全自动（PI_WEB_BRIDGE_AUTO=1 任何 CLI 会话自动上桥）；followUp 排队回显 + 图片附件透传 + 空闲超时退出
extensions.descriptionEn: ; supports full automation via environment variables (PI_WEB_BRIDGE_AUTO=1 auto-bridges any CLI session); followUp queue echo + image attachment passthrough + idle time
extensions.soulEn: Don't grab the steering wheel — the agent is already running; attach to it and watch.
extensions.soul: 不抢方向盘——agent 已经在跑，附着上去看就好。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-backup
extensions.description: pi-web 数据备份扩展（state 层快照：硬链接增量 + 保留轮转 + 源严格只读；与 aiti-configs 互补）
extensions.descriptionEn: Snapshot backup for large pi-web state data — hard-link incremental snapshots, out-of-process execution, crash-safe temp files, keepCount rotation. Complements aiti-configs, which versions small configs in git.
extensions.soulEn: config has its safety net; state deserves one too.
extensions.soul: config 有 aiti-configs，state 的大数据不该靠手动复制续命。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 桥连接探针
extensions.description: 手机端桥/SSE 连接探针（临时诊断）——页面侧采集生命周期/EventSource/fetch/心跳缺口证据落盘供 AI 分析；问题定位后应卸载
extensions.descriptionEn: pi-web extension: bridge connection probe (temporary diagnostics)
extensions.soulEn: Plug in and see what the bridge sees.
extensions.soul: SSE 断在哪一环，让证据说话。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: IM 渠道
extensions.description: IM 渠道接入 + cc-connect 大前端外壳 —— 托管 cc-connect 进程、六 tab 管理面板、机器人向导五步、对话实时流、移动端远程控制
extensions.descriptionEn: IM channel integration + a full frontend shell for cc-connect — hosts the cc-connect process, a six-tab management panel, a five-step bot wizard, live chat, and mobile remote control
extensions.soulEn: AI shouldn't be locked inside a web page — DingTalk/Feishu/WeChat are all its windows.
extensions.soul: AI 不该被锁在网页里——钉钉/飞书/微信都是它的窗口。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Claude Code 会话后端
extensions.description: 驱动 Claude Code CLI 会话 —— 从 All Sessions 恢复历史行（agentKey: claude）；claude 2.1.318+ keyring 凭据三级裁决登录态
extensions.descriptionEn: Drives Claude Code CLI sessions — restores history rows from All Sessions (agentKey: claude); claude 2.1.318+ keyring credentials with a three-tier login-state adjudication
extensions.soulEn: Historical sessions are not fossils — one click brings them back to life.
extensions.soul: 历史会话不是化石——点一下就活过来。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-cmd
extensions.description: 命令管理器 —— 真 PTY 终端 + 常用命令 + 消息识别执行 + agent 命令实时观察 + 跨扩展统一执行出口
extensions.descriptionEn: Command manager — real PTY terminal + favorite commands + message-click recognition execution + live agent command observation + a unified cross-extension execution outlet
extensions.soulEn: Leave thinking to the brain; hand commands to the favorites.
extensions.soul: 大脑留给思考，命令交给收藏夹。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: CodeBuddy Code 会话后端
extensions.description: 腾讯 CodeBuddy Code CLI（cbc）驱动 —— stream 长连接（默认）+ exec 兜底双模式 + --resume 接入 All Sessions，control_request 三通道，API-key env 登录
extensions.descriptionEn: Tencent CodeBuddy Code CLI (cbc) driver — stream long connection (default) + exec fallback dual mode + --resume into All Sessions, control_request three channels, API-key env login
extensions.soulEn: Tencent CodeBuddy sessions, ready to chat anywhere.
extensions.soul: 腾讯 CodeBuddy 会话，哪儿都能接上聊。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-codebuddy-agent/ 后 reload
# 需要本机可用 cbc：npm i -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code（或依赖 npx 兜底）

extensions.name: 研发平台
extensions.description: 云效 / GitHub / Gitee / GitLab 的工作项与代码库统一入口——工作项搜索 / 详情 / 评论、仓库与分支、克隆到工作区、建合并请求；多账号；AI 工具 + skills
extensions.descriptionEn: CodeHub — one hub for work items and repositories across Yunxiao / GitHub / Gitee / GitLab: search / detail / comments, repositories and branches, clone into a workspace, merge requests; multi-account; AI tools + skills
extensions.soulEn: Requirements, branches and sessions in one place.
extensions.soul: 需求、分支、会话，在同一个地方。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Codex 会话后端
extensions.description: OpenAI Codex CLI driver —— exec --json + resume 接入 All Sessions；认证双轨（auth.json OAuth / openrouter env），直播与冷回放同形原生工具卡
extensions.descriptionEn: OpenAI Codex CLI driver — exec --json + resume integrated into All Sessions; dual-track auth (auth.json OAuth / openrouter env), live streaming and cold replay render identically-shaped native tool cards
extensions.soulEn: Wherever Codex runs, the panel watches.
extensions.soul: Codex 在哪儿跑，面板就在哪儿看。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 配置版本化 + 崩溃自检
extensions.description: 配置的安全网 —— AI/人改配置、改扩展改坏了，有锅可回、有 diff 可看、一键恢复；系统崩了，命令行哨兵不依赖出问题系统本身兜底恢复
extensions.descriptionEn: A safety net for configuration — when AI/humans or extension changes break the config, there is a commit to revert, a diff to inspect, one-click restore; if the system crashes, a command-line watchdog recovers without relying on the broken system itself
extensions.soulEn: The AI dares to change recklessly, because an entire git repo stands behind it as the undo button.
extensions.soul: AI 敢乱改，因为身后有一整个 git 当后悔药。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 流畅度检测器
extensions.description: 主线程流畅度检测——读秒 + 0-100 分 + 颜色分层 + 最小化 + AI 卡顿调试（aiti-helper 帮助点）；可注入任意站点（内部版/外部版双产物）
extensions.descriptionEn: Main-thread smoothness detector — a seconds counter + 0–100 smoothness score + color tiers + minimize + AI jank debugging. Ships as two artifacts: a pi-web extension (internal) and a standalone single-file injector you can register into any website you develop.
extensions.soulEn: A stalled main thread stops the clock; one score tells busy from idle.
extensions.soul: 卡不卡，让数字说话；元凶是谁，让 AI 说话。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 崩溃演习
extensions.description: flag 写入 → startup throw → ⚠ 指示器 + restore-ext 幂等清除——崩溃自愈链路的演习工具
extensions.descriptionEn: Fatal crash-testing extension (dev only): deliberately breaks one core file to verify the full recovery loop (global-error rescue page / partial startup failure / CLI watchdog)
extensions.soulEn: Rehearse the crash; don't wait for it.
extensions.soul: 崩溃要演，不要等。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-ctx-meter
extensions.description: 输入区上下文比例条指示器——桌面 compactLead 竖向比例条 + 小屏 modelInfoLead 前导位，urgency 四档色阶 + critical 呼吸，点击开宿主会话统计面板
extensions.descriptionEn: Input-area context ratio-bar indicator — desktop compactLead vertical bar + small-screen modelInfoLead leading slot, four-tier urgency color scale + critical breathing, click opens the host session stats panel
extensions.soulEn: How much context is left — one glance at the battery tells you.
extensions.soul: 上下文还剩多少，看一眼电池就知道。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Cursor CLI 会话接入
extensions.description: 驱动 Cursor Agent CLI 会话（agentKey: cursor）——stream-json print 模式 + --resume 多轮；Cursor IDE 会话只读解析
extensions.descriptionEn: Drives Cursor Agent CLI sessions (agentKey: cursor) — stream-json print mode + --resume multi-turn; Cursor IDE sessions parsed read-only
extensions.soulEn: Bring Cursor's agent into pi-web's session universe too.
extensions.soul: Cursor 的会话，也进 All Sessions。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 自定义 Agent
extensions.description: UI 表单注册自定义会话后端——启动命令 + 参数前缀 + 成员 env + 桥模式，保存即热生效；generic 驱动 one-shot spawn（docker 化 / 命令包装 / 同一 CLI 多配置）
extensions.descriptionEn: Register custom session backends with a UI form — launch command + args prefix + member env + bridge mode, hot effective on save; generic driver one-shot spawn (dockerized / command wrapping / multiple configs for the same CLI)
extensions.soulEn: One command line, one backend.
extensions.soul: 一行命令，一个后端；docker 里跑 agent，从此不再手写配置。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: AITI Debug Inject
extensions.description: 极简远程调试注入 —— 把另一个 pi-web 实例的调试器注入本实例页面，服务地址是 extman 里的文本 feature，默认关闭
extensions.descriptionEn: Minimal remote-debug injection — injects another pi-web instance's debugger into this instance's pages; the service URL is a text feature in extman, off by default
extensions.soulEn: Which outfit the debugger wears is up to you.
extensions.soul: 调试器该穿在哪件衣服里，由你说了算。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti devtools
extensions.description: pi-web 扩展 —— 注入器 / 桥 / MCP server 端 + agent 工具进程内注入
extensions.descriptionEn: pi-web extension — in-page AI debugging workbench: launcher + client injection, CDP-like commands, and a bridge that hands page capabilities to any AI agent as MCP tools
extensions.soulEn: AI shouldn't squint blindly at a screen; it should truly see the page.
extensions.soul: AI 不该对着屏幕瞎猜，它该真正看见页面。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 文档中心
extensions.description: workspace md 收集/整理/检索——FTS5 trigram 中文全文 + tag 七来源两层 + 📚 float 弹窗四视图
extensions.descriptionEn: workspace markdown collection/organization/search — FTS5 trigram Chinese full-text + tag seven-source two-layer + 📚 float dialog four views
extensions.soul: 文档不检索，等于没写。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 草稿保管员
extensions.description: 草稿持久化 + 恢复接管 —— composer 契约 v2 唯一所有者（applyIntent 唯一写入口）、多标签共享槽位、无贡献不回写防震荡、pruneStale 7 天清理、水合后恢复
extensions.descriptionEn: Draft persistence and crash recovery for the composer — the sole owner of the composer draft state machine (v2 intent contract), shared slots across tabs, 7-day stale pruning.
extensions.soulEn: A crash can take the page away, but not the words you were halfway through typing.
extensions.soul: 崩溃可以带走页面，带不走你打到一半的话。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Echo 会话后端
extensions.description: Echo agent —— session-provider slot 演示（多 agent 前端最小示例）
extensions.descriptionEn: Echo agent — session provider slot demo for pi-web's multi-agent frontend
extensions.soulEn: First get one echo online, then the whole army can plug in.
extensions.soul: 先让一声回声上线，再让千军万马接入。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 文件编辑器
extensions.description: 可扩展编辑器 —— Monaco 编辑接管 + 保存（mtime 冲突 409 + 白名单/大小校验）+ 压缩包解析 + 统一图片查看器（消息图片/文件图片合一，缩放·捏合·信息面板）
extensions.descriptionEn: Extensible editor — Monaco editing take over + save (mtime conflict 409 + whitelist/size checks) + archive extraction + unified image viewer (message images and file images unified, zoom · pinch · info panel)
extensions.soulEn: See wrong code, fix it on the spot — no switching out to open an IDE.
extensions.soul: 看到不对的代码，当场就能改——不用切出去开 IDE。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 页面事件总线
extensions.description: 页面事件总线归口——链式接管 __piPageEvents，v0.2 主题订阅（按 type 白名单过滤转发）+ publish-local 高频直连 + subscribe-topics 客户端出口，core 零改动；topics 唯一、禁止任何兜底
extensions.descriptionEn: The page event bus for pi-web: takes over `__piPageEvents`, topic subscriptions with server-side filtering, publish-local for high-frequency frames, load-priority guarantee, and STALE_CONN silent rebuild.
extensions.soulEn: One bus, every frame.
extensions.soul: 一条总线，全部帧。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-extman
extensions.description: 扩展管理器 —— 搜索/启停/安装/在线注册表
extensions.descriptionEn: Extension manager — search / enable-disable / install / online registry
extensions.soulEn: The one managing extensions should be an extension itself.
extensions.soul: 管扩展的，也该是个扩展。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 弹窗浮动增强器
extensions.description: data-ext-float 契约接管 —— 拖拽/边缘缩放/位置持久化/点按置前/双击复位/自动最大化按钮，小屏自动全屏 + 系统返回关闭浮窗；DockStack 左栏统一区块栈服务
extensions.descriptionEn: data-ext-float contract take-over — drag/edge resize/position persistence/click-to-front/double-click reset/auto maximize button, small-screen auto fullscreen + system back closes the float; the DockStack unified sidebar block-stack service
extensions.soulEn: The panel just sets one attribute; everything about floating is left to it.
extensions.soul: 面板只管标一个属性，浮起来的一切交给它。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 文件夹浏览器
extensions.description: fileViewer folder 接管 + pathPicker 目录选择器 —— 浏览/回收站删除 + git 工具条、嵌套仓库独立提交与分组提交计划（软依赖 aiti-git-ops）
extensions.descriptionEn: fileViewer folder take-over + pathPicker directory picker — browse / delete to trash + git toolbar, nested-repo commits and grouped commit plans (soft-depends on aiti-git-ops)
extensions.soulEn: The directory tree is not the end of navigation — it is the start of action.
extensions.soul: 目录树不是导航的终点，是操作的起点。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Git Ops 共享引擎
extensions.description: 白名单 git 写引擎——checkout 预检 / stash / plan 断点 / 审计 / changed topic，供 folder 与 session-manager 消费
extensions.descriptionEn: Whitelisted git write engine — checkout precheck / stash / plan breakpoints / audit / changed topic, consumed by folder and session-manager
extensions.soulEn: One place to write the repo, every place stays safe.
extensions.soul: 一处写仓，处处安全。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Git 代码审核
extensions.description: 专职审核未提交变更 —— Monaco diff 工作区（并排/合并/纯新/大纲）+ 行级标注（必须/建议/疑问）+ anchor 标志行重映射（边审边改不失效）+ 汇总终审清单 + AI 预审（aiti_review_* 工具只注入评审会话，日常零工具）
extensions.descriptionEn: Dedicated to reviewing uncommitted changes — Monaco diff workspace (side-by-side/merged/new-only/outline) + line-level annotations (must/suggest/question) + anchor flag-line re-mapping (stays valid while editing mid-review) + summary final-review checklist + AI pre-review (aiti_review_* tools injected only into review sessions, zero tools day-to-day)
extensions.soulEn: As a human, this is my last stubborn stand against AI.
extensions.soul: 作为人类，这是我对抗ai的最后倔犟了
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: AI 变更追踪
extensions.description: 编外 AI 变更追踪——仓根 .aiti-trace 独立追踪仓（无 git 也可 autoInit）+ op 编号 before/after 双 commit + 文件⇄消息⇄操作全链路 + 回撤 + 影子仓瘦身 compact
extensions.descriptionEn: Out-of-band AI change tracking — repo-root .aiti-trace standalone trace repo (autoInit even without git) + op-numbered before/after dual commits + full file⇄message⇄op lineage + rollback + shadow repo slimming compact
extensions.soul: AI 改过的每一行都有账。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: AI Helper
extensions.description: 全扩展的一句话 AI 能力入口 —— 声明式 AI 帮助点（pi skills 标准）+ 输入/结果预览/审核回填 + 流式进度总线交付 + 多轮追问 + 历史与后台任务 + 用户自定义 skills（配置版本化已独立为 aiti-configs）
extensions.descriptionEn: The one-sentence AI capability entry for all extensions — declarative AI help points (pi skills standard) + input/result preview/review-and-fill-back + streaming progress bus delivery + multi-turn follow-ups + history and background tasks + user-defined skills (config versioning has been split out as aiti-configs)
extensions.soulEn: AI's tools should be wired up and evolved by AI itself — humanity's role is to steer, not to haul bricks.
extensions.soul: AI 的工具该由 AI 自己接线、自己进化——人类的角色是掌舵，不是搬砖。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-mail
extensions.description: pi-web 内通用「邮件发送出口」——零依赖 SMTP 客户端 + 发送记录（node:sqlite）+ 管理弹窗（配置/测试/记录）
extensions.descriptionEn: The general "mail sending outlet" inside pi-web — zero-dependency SMTP client + send log (node:sqlite) + management dialog (config/test/log)
extensions.soul: 配置一次 SMTP，pi-web 里任何扩展和 AI 都能发邮件。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 模型可用性管理
extensions.description: 模型健康度探测 —— 对每个模型发极小探针消息，看是否可用 / 429 限流 / 异常；解析限流恢复时间（Retry-After 等），记录历史识别可用窗口；长期限流到期提醒（纯本地时间检查零探测）
extensions.descriptionEn: Model health probing — sends a tiny probe message to each model to check availability / 429 rate limiting / errors; parses the rate-limit recovery time (Retry-After etc.), records history to identify availability windows; long-term rate-limit expiry reminders (pure local time checks, zero probing)
extensions.soulEn: Is the model home? Knock and ask.
extensions.soul: 模型在不在家，敲门问问它。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-model-recent
extensions.description: 模型选择器「最近使用」数据提供方——纯 service 扩展（零 UI），面板最近段同步取数 + pick 事件入库 LRU；localStorage key 与原实现一致零迁移
extensions.descriptionEn: The model selector's "recently used" data provider — a pure service extension (zero UI); the panel's recent section fetches data synchronously and pick events feed the LRU; the localStorage key matches the original implementation, zero migration
extensions.soulEn: Frequently used models should be at your fingertips.
extensions.soul: 常用的模型，应当在指尖。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-model-recent/ 后 reload（需宿主 ≥ service 接缝版本，defork P4）

extensions.name: 模型添加向导
extensions.description: 引导添加 AI 提供商/模型：目录搜索（models.dev + 国内 AI 目录，中英文，贴 API 地址也能反向搜到）→ 填 token → 测试（2xx/429 都算通过）→ 选/输模型 → 写 models.json；找不到用 baseUrl 反向匹配（任意文档/代码片段自动提取 URL）/ 自动探测（漏 v1/v2 也能补，命中带 key 拉模型列表 + OpenAPI/模型前缀品牌信号）；编辑时 token 打码不返回前端
extensions.descriptionEn: Guided AI provider/model onboarding — catalog search (models.dev + domestic AI catalog, Chinese/English, paste an API URL to reverse-search) → enter token → test (both 2xx/429 count as pass) → pick/type a model → write models.json; on miss, baseUrl reverse matching (auto-extracts URLs from any doc/code snippet) or auto detection (fills missing v1/v2, pulls the model list with a key + OpenAPI/model-prefix brand signals); tokens are masked on every read and never returned to the frontend
extensions.soulEn: Addresses, tokens, signup pages — keys scattered far and wide, strung into one chain.
extensions.soul: 地址、token、注册页——散落四方的钥匙，串成一串。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 模型配置导入
extensions.description: 其他 agent models 配置导入——扫描 codex/ZCode/OpenCode 的 provider·模型配置成草稿，首启弹窗一次性引导导入；落盘一律经 aiti-model-wizard saveBatch（可一步撤销），绝不直写 models.json
extensions.descriptionEn: Imports model configs from other agents — scans codex / ZCode / OpenCode provider·model configs into drafts (first-launch dialog for a one-time import); persistence always goes through aiti-model-wizard saveBatch (undoable in one step), never writes models.json directly
extensions.soul: 不抄配置，只搬家。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 消息锚点横幅
extensions.description: 消息区顶部常驻横幅 —— 展示「生成当前屏幕上内容的那条用户输入」，滚动跟随回合段；可切换为第一条输入 / 最近输入 / 会话标题
extensions.descriptionEn: A persistent banner at the top of the message area — shows "the user input that generated the content currently at the top of your screen", following turn segments as you scroll; switchable to first input / latest input / session title
extensions.soulEn: Replying to the wrong person's words is more awkward than calling someone the wrong name.
extensions.soul: 回错了人的话，比叫错名字还尴尬。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 消息滚动导航
extensions.description: 消息区右侧的滚动导航条 —— 到最早 / 到最新 / 上一个 / 下一个用户输入，一键直达；长按「到最新」保持屏幕常亮
extensions.descriptionEn: A scroll navigation bar on the right side of the message area — to earliest / to latest / previous / next user input, one-click direct access; long-press "to latest" keeps the screen awake
extensions.soulEn: For chat histories thousands of stories tall, the elevator beats the stairs.
extensions.soul: 千楼万楼的聊天记录，电梯比楼梯好用。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 消息分享
extensions.description: 把会话、单条消息、划选内容、文件与图片分享出去——工作台跑在自己机器上、外网访问不到，所以经可配置的分享目标（Gitee / 图床 / 对象存储 / 笔记库，内置 161 个）上传换回公网 URL，上传前自动脱敏，结果附二维码
extensions.descriptionEn: Share sessions, messages, selections, files and images through pluggable targets with secret redaction and QR codes
extensions.soulEn: Sharing it out is how the conversation continues.
extensions.soul: 分享出去，是为了让对话继续。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 随 aiti-agent（@aiti-ai/pi-web）打包，在应用内扩展管理器启用

extensions.name: 消息智能
extensions.description: 消息点击识别 —— 段落/标题/代码行点击 → 引用/复制/选项弹层 + 子句/行高亮
extensions.descriptionEn: Message click recognition — paragraph/heading/code-line clicks → quote/copy/option popups + clause/line highlighting
extensions.soulEn: However well the AI says it, copying it is still a chore.
extensions.soul: AI 说得再好，抄起来也挺费劲。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Oh My Pi Agent
extensions.description: Oh My Pi (omp.sh)——pi 最大 fork 的 RPC spawn 后端（拆分自 aiti-pi-agent 专一 omp）：omp --mode rpc 子进程 + ready 握手 / get_state 能力面 / host tools / login / branch
extensions.descriptionEn: Oh My Pi (omp.sh) — RPC spawn backend for pi's largest fork (split from aiti-pi-agent to specialize in omp): `omp --mode rpc` child process + ready handshake / get_state capability surface / host tools / login / branch
extensions.soulEn: omp's independent world: ready handshake / get_state capability surface / host tools / login / branch.
extensions.soul: omp 的独立世界：ready 握手 / get_state 能力面 / host tools / login / branch。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 需本机装有 omp（bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent，bun ≥1.3.14），或 OMP_CLI 指定路径

extensions.name: OnlyOffice 深度保真编辑
extensions.description: .docx/.xlsx/.pptx 完整保真预览+编辑（OnlyOffice DocumentServer Docker 后端）。AGPL 社区版，feature 默认关
extensions.descriptionEn: Full-fidelity preview + editing for .docx/.xlsx/.pptx (OnlyOffice DocumentServer Docker backend). AGPL community edition, feature off by default
extensions.soul: 深度保真档——与桌面 Office 同引擎，复杂排版编辑不将就。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 1) 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-onlyoffice/ 后 reload
# 2) 启动 DocumentServer：scripts/onlyoffice-up.sh（Docker，常态 ~2G 内存）
# 3) 扩展管理器 → aiti-onlyoffice → 功能 → 勾选「启用 OnlyOffice」并刷新页面
# 依赖：aiti-editor（多编辑器仲裁宿主）+ Docker
extensions.license: AGPL-3.0（OnlyOffice DocumentServer 社区版，可选 Docker 档不装即无）

extensions.name: pi 会话后端
extensions.description: spawn pi --mode rpc 子进程作为会话 —— 多 agent 前端主路径
extensions.descriptionEn: Spawns a pi --mode rpc child process as a session — the main path of the multi-agent frontend
extensions.soulEn: The most orthodox path in All Sessions — pi drives itself.
extensions.soul: All Sessions 里最正统的一条路——pi 自己驱动自己。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 方案先行
extensions.description: AI 开发先方案后动手 —— aiti-git-trace 事件感知（推-听架构零扫描）：md 变更弹绑定向导（方案命名优先）、大改未跟方案提醒、领先提醒「先做方案」、tags 闭环（front-matter 事实源 + 手工/自荐标签）、会话列表行前部 📋 绑定标
extensions.descriptionEn: Plan-first reminder extension — listens to aiti-git-trace events: bind md changes to a wizard, flag large changes without a plan, and insert "update plan doc: @file" in one click
extensions.soulEn: Think it through before touching the keyboard — plans are cheapest when written first.
extensions.soul: 不强制不打断，只在 md 变了和大改跑偏时轻轻提一句：先有方案，再动手。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 依赖：aiti-git-trace ≥0.2.0（services.trace v2 事件出口；缺席自动休眠，手动绑定仍可用）
# pi 扩展 emit 需重启 pi 进程生效（终端桥接会话不触发自动提醒——见方案文档 §9）；另需
#   aiti-prompts（slogan 提示词编辑）、aiti-doc-center（tag 词表/🧵 会话视图消费绑定标）

extensions.name: 方案评审
extensions.description: Plan-Sandbox 采认收尾 UI——读 review.json 契约（声明 vs 其他），采认选中并关闭沙箱 / 仅保存（保留沙箱）/ 全部丢弃 + 沙箱历史（重新提取/重用/销毁）
extensions.descriptionEn: Plan-Sandbox sign-off UI — reads the review.json contract (declared vs. others) and lets you adopt / roll back / discard in one click
extensions.soulEn: A plan is only done when someone signs off on the diff.
extensions.soul: 方案落地前，最后一道闸。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-proc-tree
extensions.description: 子进程管理——树形列出 pi-web 生态派生的子进程（终端/隧道/子代理/外部 Agent），实时 CPU/内存，可结束单进程或整棵子树；面板打开才采样，折叠即停
extensions.descriptionEn: Child-process tree manager — every process the pi-web ecosystem spawns (terminals, tunnels, subagents, external agents) with live CPU/memory and subtree stop; samples only while the panel is open
extensions.soulEn: Who is running, how much it eats, where it came from — one tree, one click to stop.
extensions.soul: 谁在跑、吃多少、从哪来——一棵树看全，点一下就能停。

extensions.name: aiti prompt 片段收藏库
extensions.description: prompt 片段收藏 —— 收藏/分组/会话提取/输入即存
extensions.descriptionEn: Prompt snippet collection — favorites/groups/session extraction/save-as-you-type
extensions.soulEn: My input is my precious fortune — good lines are never typed twice.
extensions.soul: 我的输入是我宝贵的财富——好话不说二遍。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-provider-usage
extensions.description: Provider 余额/配额查询 —— 16 个适配器 id（DeepSeek/OpenRouter/Z.AI/OpenCode Go/Kimi/Codex/Copilot 等），会话信息面板「剩余额度」区块当前会话置顶展开，5min TTL 总览 + 手动刷新，事件驱动零轮询
extensions.descriptionEn: Provider balance/quota lookup — 16 adapter ids (DeepSeek/OpenRouter/Z.AI/OpenCode Go/Kimi/Codex/Copilot etc.), session info panel "remaining quota" section with the current session pinned on top, 5min TTL overview + manual refresh, event-driven zero polling
extensions.soulEn: How much quota each provider has left, all on one panel.
extensions.soul: 各家还剩多少额度，一面看尽。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-provider-usage/ 后 reload（需宿主 pi-web ≥ sessionInfoPanel 插槽版本，defork B1）

extensions.name: Qoder 会话后端
extensions.description: Qoder CLI 专属后端 —— 双区域 credits/listModels、WASM 签名请求、扩展 API 免开会话查询
extensions.descriptionEn: Exclusive Qoder CLI session backend (qodercli/qoderclicn): credits/quota (getUsage), WASM-signed model catalog (listModels), task-list mirror, run-queue management, and plan/permission-mode support.
extensions.soulEn: Others take the ACP highway; it insists on the signed single-plank bridge — because the scenery is on the other side.
extensions.soul: 别人走 ACP 大路，它偏要走签名的独木桥——因为风景在对面。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Queue Keeper
extensions.description: 队列面板接管 —— 完整队列 UI（横幅/行操作/拖拽排序/回收站/撤销条/导入导出），core 回到上游同形兜底
extensions.descriptionEn: Full queue panel for the composer (queuePanel-slot takeover): banners, row operations (move / drag / steer-send / to-followUp / recall / delete) and a recycle bin — fully client-side.
extensions.soulEn: Queuing isn't scary; what's scary is forgetting what you wanted to say after queuing.
extensions.soul: 排队不可怕，可怕的是排完队忘了自己要说什么。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 快速上手
extensions.description: 空白态引导扩展——新建会话欢迎页 widget（上手步骤 / 快捷操作 / 任务运行时 / 示例提示词，走宿主 newSessionWidgets 插槽可 ⚙ 自定义）+ 左栏 DockStack 全折叠空白引导卡（与应用中心同屏共存，✕ 可关闭）+ v2 工作区获取 Hub（Git 克隆 / 上传压缩包 / 本地目录 / 新建）+ 侧栏「快速上手」静态条目（应用中心可钉住卡片，点击重返 quickstart 欢迎页）
extensions.descriptionEn: Blank-state onboarding extension — new-session welcome page widgets (getting-started steps / quick actions / while-it-runs concepts / sample prompts, via the host newSessionWidgets slot, ⚙ customizable) + a left sidebar DockStack fully-collapsed blank guide card (shares the screen with the app center, ✕ dismissible) + a v2 workspace-acquisition Hub (Git clone / upload archive / local directory / create new) + a sidebar "Quick Start" static entry (pinnable as a card in the app center; clicking returns to the quickstart welcome page)
extensions.soulEn: A blank slate is nothing to fear; your first sentence starts here.
extensions.soul: 空白不可怕，第一句从这里开始。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 消费方 session-manager（optionalDependsOn 软依赖）经 aiti-quickstart.api 服务渲染进 DockStack filler（上半，应用中心在下）；
# 另软依赖 aiti-event-bus（clone 进度帧）与 aiti-model-wizard（配置模型深链，缺席降级）

extensions.name: aiti-recovery
extensions.description: 恢复 UI 扩展——队列恢复对话框（会话中断排队消息逐条决议）+ 重启恢复向导（中断会话两步处理），红线语义保留：绝不自动投递，续跑只发「继续」
extensions.descriptionEn: Recovery UI extension — queue recovery dialog (resolving queued messages left by interrupted sessions one by one) + restart recovery wizard (two-step handling of interrupted sessions), red-line semantics preserved: never auto-deliver, resuming only sends "continue"
extensions.soulEn: Interruption isn't scary; what's scary is not finding the way back.
extensions.soul: 中断不可怕，可怕的是找不到回去的路。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install: # 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-recovery/ 后 reload（需宿主 ≥ recoveryDialog 插槽版本，defork B3）

extensions.name: aiti-secret-vault 密钥库管理
extensions.description: pi-web 的加密密钥库管理弹窗——别名查看/新增/轮换/查看明文/删除、锁定/解锁、keyfile ↔ 系统钥匙串切换、会话挂载总览；值只走浏览器→本机服务→加密库，不经过 AI 对话
extensions.descriptionEn: Encrypted secret vault management UI for pi-web: list / add / rotate / reveal / remove aliases, lock/unlock, switch between keyfile and OS-keychain unlock, and inspect which aliases are mounted per session. Values never enter the AI conversation.
extensions.soulEn: Manage the vault in the browser; the AI only gets tokens.
extensions.soul: 在网页里管库，AI 永远只拿令牌。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: 会话请求卡
extensions.description: 会话请求卡扩展——交互元语卡（zcode 方案审批 / AskUser / omp OAuth / generic 兜底）与工具授权卡完整 UI，自 pi-web core 外迁（agent 能力 UI 去核化 P1）
extensions.descriptionEn: Session request card extension — full UI for interaction-primitive cards (zcode plan approval / AskUser / omp OAuth / generic fallback) and tool authorization cards
extensions.soulEn: The cards where an agent begs you for an answer — what they look like is the extension's call.
extensions.soul: agent 求你作答的卡片，长什么样由扩展说了算。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: Excel 表格编辑器
extensions.description: .xlsx/.xlsm 在线预览+编辑（exceljs 数据面 + Univer 视图面）；.xls/.ods 只读预览与一键转 .xlsx
extensions.descriptionEn: In-browser preview + editing for .xlsx/.xlsm (exceljs data layer + Univer view layer); read-only preview and one-click convert to .xlsx for .xls/.ods
extensions.soul: 老格式不挡路——转换、派生、编辑各归其位。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-sheet-univer/ 后 reload
# 依赖：aiti-editor（多编辑器仲裁宿主）；服务器端转换需 LibreOffice (soffice)
extensions.license: MIT（本扩展；exceljs MIT + Univer Apache-2.0 + @e965/xlsx Apache-2.0）

extensions.name: 子代理
extensions.description: 子代理舰队 Fleet 观测/运行控制/Agent 管理/并发配置——fork 引擎，工具归上游 pi-subagents
extensions.descriptionEn: Subagent fleet — Fleet observation / run control / agent management / concurrency config — fork engine, tools belong to upstream pi-subagents
extensions.soulEn: The main agent does the thinking; the dirty work goes to the specialist.
extensions.soul: 主 agent 负责思考，脏活累活分给专职的它。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: aiti-sysmon
extensions.description: 服务器状态查看器——左栏停靠面板实时查看 pi-web 所在主机的 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 网络 / 温度 / 传感器，面板打开才采样、折叠即停，服务端零常驻开销
extensions.descriptionEn: Server status viewer — sidebar dock panel for the pi-web host machine: CPU / memory / disk / network / temperature (systeminformation based)
extensions.soulEn: How busy is the server? One glance at the left sidebar tells you.
extensions.soul: 服务器忙不忙，开左栏看一眼就知道。
extensions.author: aiti-ai

extensions.name: TestAgent
extensions.description: Java 后端 AI 调试 MCP + IDE —— 扫描 Java 进程/attach 一键连桥/Tunnel 桥多端点纳管，JVM 内任意修改/Mock·SQL 拦截模拟/热更新/诊断采样，58 工具 10 组按需暴露，全可逆
extensions.descriptionEn: AI debugging MCP + IDE for Java backends — scan Java processes / attach one-click bridge connect / tunnel-bridge multi-endpoint management; arbitrary in-JVM modification / Mock & SQL interception simulation / hot updates / diagnostic sampling; 57 tools in 10 groups exposed on demand, fully reversible
extensions.soul: 所有操作可逆（delete/stop 还原），AI 放心在运行中的 JVM 里做实验。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 1) 目标 JVM 挂载 agent（httpPort 开出 HTTP API；也可运行后用 ta_attach 动态挂载）
java -javaagent:testagent.jar=conf-dir -Dtestagent.httpPort=8564 -jar app.jar
# 2) MCP 客户端（~/.config/mcp/mcp.json）加：
"aiti-testagent": { "command": "node", "args": ["<dev-repo>/mcp-testagent.cjs"] }
# 3) 按组过滤暴露面（可选）：--tools "lifecycle observe jvm" --exclude ta_heapdump
# 开关多时不必堆 -D：项目根放 testagent.properties（testagent.* 前缀），从子目录启动自动向上发现

extensions.name: TestAgent Native 面板
extensions.description: testagent-native（Windows 原生进程活体操控）可视面 —— broker 进程/会话/挂钩/事件流；原 aiti-wintrace（2026-11-07 改名）
extensions.descriptionEn: Visual panel for testagent-native (live Windows-native process control) — broker processes/sessions/hooks/event stream; formerly aiti-wintrace (renamed 2026-11-07)
extensions.soul: 任意 Windows 进程→AI 可编程工具面：API/COM 调用级追踪、原生求值、mock 覆写、函数体热替换，全可逆审计。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 1) 常驻 tan broker（155：Startup 文件夹 start-tan.vbs——broker 8765/8766 + MCP HTTP 8767）
#    手动：D:\path\to\testagent-native\native\build\win64-release\bin\<current-broker.txt> --port 8765 --http-port 8766
# 2) 本面板随 pi-web 扩展部署自动生效（工具条「Win」入口）；数据源 broker HTTP 8766（env TAN_BROKER_HTTP 可改）
# 3) AI 侧走 testagent-native-mcp：node mcp/testagent-native-mcp/register.js（52 tan_* + 7 app_* 工具）

extensions.name: UI 环境（桌面/无头虚拟屏）
extensions.description: 后台无头服务器 UI 调试的环境分配器 —— 4 态模式裁决新启动 MCP/应用的显示环境，Xvfb+openbox+AT-SPI 虚拟屏 + VNC-on-web + RDP-on-web，Linux/Windows/macOS 三平台服务化；VNC 密码由 VNC server 自己认证（桥纯透传）
extensions.descriptionEn: Environment allocator for UI debugging on headless background servers — a 4-state mode arbiter decides whether newly launched MCP/apps land on a real desktop or an Xvfb headless virtual display (Xvfb+openbox+picom+AT-SPI virtual display + VNC-on-web + RDP-on-web), service-ized on Linux/Windows/macOS; the VNC password is authenticated by the VNC server itself (the bridge is pure passthrough)
extensions.soulEn: No monitor needed — there can still be a stage.
extensions.soul: 没有显示器，也可以有舞台。
extensions.author: aiti-ai
extensions.install:
# 部署到 ~/.pi/web/extensions/aiti-ui-env/ 后 reload：
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/api/extensions/reload

integrations.description: pi 的加密持久密钥库——/vault add 掩码录入，模型只拿 rsec_<hash8> 稳定令牌（vault_list / vault_get），工具执行前自动还原真值；AI 只读、值 AES-256-GCM 加密落盘（keyfile / 系统钥匙串）、session JSONL 零真值
integrations.descriptionEn: Encrypted secret vault for pi: store credentials once (/vault add, masked input), let the model query aliases (vault_list / vault_get → opaque rsec_ tokens) and pass those tokens into any tool argument, where the runtime substitutes the real value. AI is read-only; values never enter the chat, the session file, or the wire payload. Superset of @aiti-ai/pi-secret-mask (same engine; same-session coexistence resolves to the vault).
integrations.soul: 库在你手，令牌给 AI。
integrations.author: aiti-ai
integrations.install: pi install npm:@aiti-ai/pi-secret-vault

integrations.name: pi-session-search 会话搜索
integrations.description: 给 pi 编码代理加 session_search / session_read 只读工具——跨历史会话全文搜索（经 pi-web session-manager 索引可覆盖所有 agent 家族）+ 读原始消息，恢复被 compaction 吃掉的上下文、找回"上次怎么做的"
integrations.descriptionEn: Give the pi agent session_search / session_read tools: full-text search across past sessions (optionally every agent family via a pi-web session-manager index) and read original messages — recover context lost to compaction, find how something was done before. A pi package.
integrations.soul: compaction 吃掉的上下文，一句搜索全找回来。
integrations.author: aiti-ai
integrations.install:
# 安装（pi 包）：pi install @aiti-ai/pi-session-search
# 或源码直连：
pi -e /path/to/pi-session-search/src/index.ts
# pi-web 会话无需安装：session_search/session_read 由 session-manager 注入

integrations.name: pi-subagents 子 agent 委派
integrations.description: pi 编码代理的子 agent 委派插件（aiti fork）——单 agent 委派 + 脚本化多 agent 工作流（并行/后台/council 顾问团/saved workflow/worktree 隔离），代码评审、并行审计、实现分工的第二三双眼睛
integrations.soul: 一双手忙不过来时，派几双专注的眼睛。
integrations.author: aiti-ai
integrations.install:
# settings.json npm 直连（发新版走 >dev-repo/tools/publish-all.mjs）：
pi install npm:@aiti-ai/pi-subagents

integrations.name: secret-mask-core 脱敏引擎
integrations.description: 宿主无关的秘密脱敏基础能力包——确定性凭据检测规则、rsec_<hash8> 令牌 Registry（legacy [REDACTED:*] 兼容）、深遍历还原/脱敏、pi 消息适配、未挂载占位符 guard、落盘三态、自定义规则、payload 审计与 /secret 命令逻辑。零运行时依赖；pi 版与 DSH 版的生产实现共用，任何 TS/JS agent 四步接入
integrations.descriptionEn: Host-agnostic secret redaction engine: deterministic credential detection rules (regex + checksums + entropy + false-positive guards), credential-shaped placeholders (rsec_<hash8>, session-salted for session values and stable for vault aliases) with legacy [REDACTED:*] compatibility, deep redact/restore traversal, pi AgentMessage adapters (context / system / message_end), unresolved-placeholder guard, three-state landing policy (plain/vault/ephemeral), custom JSON rules, final-payload leak auditing, and the /secret command logic. Shared by @aiti-ai/pi-secret-mask, @aiti-ai/pi-secret-vault (via @aiti-ai/secret-vault-core) and @aiti-ai/dsh-secret-mask; any TS/JS agent can adapt it by mapping its message shapes to text spans.
integrations.soul: 一套检测引擎，所有 agent 共享同一份"随手贴，不泄密"。
integrations.author: aiti-ai
integrations.install: npm i @aiti-ai/secret-mask-core
